name: Rider Report
description: Rider Report is a group project created during my involvement in the Everyone Can Code Chicago App Accelerator Program. The app is made for Chicago CTA train users to report issues/crimes with/on CTA trains to promote increased change and investment in the city's public transit system.

name: EnSub
description: EnSub is a terminal-based application that is meant to create a more efficient way of managing a Gmail inbox.
